items.markdown:
Thailand's nightlife is famous around the world , offering everything from `loud backpacker streets and luxury sky bars to wild beach parties` . The top spots to visit are Bangkok, Phuket, and Pattaya.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1XxMKTQqYvs&vl=en&t=775) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1XxMKTQqYvs&vl=en&t=775)[[2]](https://www.thomascook.com/holidays/thailand/things-to-do/nightlife)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/brothersholidaysadventure/videos/-nightlife-in-thailand-the-city-that-never-sleepsexperience-thailand-after-dark-/1431310191964732/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tBrGeyUR8Yg)[[5]](https://intersightholidays.com/destination/thailand/places-to-visit)

Bangkok Nightlife

Bangkok is the capital city and has many different areas for a night out.

- **Khaosan Road:** A busy 400-meter street filled with cheap bucket drinks, loud music, and backpackers.
- **Sukhumvit (Soi 11):** A modern strip with popular pubs, restaurants, and big nightclubs.
- **Rooftop Bars:** Fancy high-rise spots like *Sky Bar at Lebua* and *Vertigo* offer great city views.
- **RCA (Royal City Avenue):** A huge street dedicated to massive electronic dance music clubs.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1XxMKTQqYvs&vl=en&t=775) [[1]](https://bangkoknightlife.com/)

Beach Clubs and Islands If you want parties by the ocean, the islands and beach towns are the place to be.

- **Phuket (Patong Beach):** Bangla Road turns into a neon-light walking street at night with open-air bars and dancers.
- **Koh Phangan:** Famous for the monthly **Full Moon Party** , where thousands dance on the sand with fire shows and music.[](https://www.roafly.com/blog/thailand-nightlife) [[1]](https://www.roafly.com/blog/thailand-nightlife)[[2]](https://www.siamrealestate.com/info-phuket-nightlife)[[3]](https://www.pentravel.co.za/blog/unlocking-the-best-of-thailand-7-authentic-experiences/)[[4]](https://www.hellothailand.co.za/phuket/)

Pattaya Nightlife

- **Walking Street Pattaya:** A loud, energetic 1-kilometer strip packed with seafood restaurants, go-go bars, and live music.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ik4iJXVVHzo&vl=en&t=221) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ik4iJXVVHzo&vl=en&t=221)[[2]](https://yourthaiguide.com/walking-street-pattayas-legendary-nightlife-hub/)[[3]](https://www.akbartravels.com/in/blogs/top-tips-nightlife-pattaya/)[[4]](https://www.agoda.com/travel-guides/thailand/pattaya/experience-pattaya-walking-street-your-ultimate-night-out-guide/)[[5]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/CpAgrU8pS_R/)

For a quick look at the neon lights and energetic crowds on Bangkok's famous party street:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSqZ-g-RCXfgWg-vLwlzRGpCtRMnmqINbBrXYzGY1w5kJYAS82e)
